findings.problem: HPU command failure left numerical state and exported files partially mutated
findings.fix: Snapshot HPU and VFS, validate postconditions, roll back quota/numerical/publication failures and delay success output

findings.problem: Zero-resident-amplitude phase retrieval could not create requested target amplitude
findings.fix: Seed deterministic zero phase when resident amplitude is undefined

findings.problem: OAM right boundary aliased the next row and inputs/counts silently coerced or wrapped
findings.fix: Bound spatial indices, enforce integer domains and saturating step budgets

findings.problem: Forged HPU recordings, counters and byte ledger claims were admitted
findings.fix: Validate paired recordings, integer counters, metadata and reproducible lane/cost ledgers

findings.problem: Legal high-amplitude sampled intensities failed the generic Float32 state codec
findings.fix: Keep finite generic Float32 values and enforce role-specific HPU array bounds

findings.problem: Mutable lookup tables and excessive Wigner requests altered or exhausted model behavior
findings.fix: Freeze tables/descriptors and bound finite coefficient/work domains

findings.problem: Canonical metadata accepted nonfinite/unsupported values and unsupported TIFF semantics were ignored
findings.fix: Enforce canonical JSON type/depth/budget constraints and reject tone/min-max/depth/CFA/DNG transforms

findings.problem: SIGINT could execute later command-list branches, including destructive virtual operations
findings.fix: Cancel the full submitted command list and stop following stages after session exit

findings.problem: Middle-stage redirection forwarded stale earlier-stage pipeline input
findings.fix: Publish empty input to following stage when redirected output is consumed

findings.problem: Output limits counted UTF-16 units, and repeated variables/aliases could grow session memory without bound
findings.fix: Enforce UTF-8 capture/stderr quotas, environment/alias storage, expanded word/argument and pending-request limits

findings.problem: Filename completion could inject shell operators/variables and invalid paths could terminate the terminal
findings.fix: Escape filename syntax before insertion and contain completion path errors

findings.problem: TIFF management commits could race arriving commands; poweroff could abort another session or survive SIGINT
findings.fix: Hold a command barrier through TIFF commit, reject power while other commands run, and honor aborted power commands

findings.problem: Imported/moved paths could exceed accessibility bounds and revision arithmetic could overflow
findings.fix: Validate complete paths/tree quotas, snapshot container budgets and safe SSD revision increments

findings.problem: Client/regex message failures left promises/timers pending
findings.fix: Bound requests and clean failed clone/send/worker/close lifecycles

findings.problem: Saved cursor after resize could crash output; reset/clear left stale wrap/scrollback budgets
findings.fix: Clamp restored cursor and reset cursor/wrap/history accounting

findings.problem: Concealed glyphs could render under the cursor and appear in accessible transcript
findings.fix: Honor conceal in renderer, cursor and transcript; validate color channels and unsupported escape forms

findings.problem: Command form accepted control bytes and Unicode translation/glob matching split supplementary characters
findings.fix: Reject all terminal controls in submitted forms and match/translate by code point

findings.problem: Copy/move silently ignored extra operands and find did not match its own file root
findings.fix: Reject unsupported operand counts, match existing root files and report missing paths

findings.problem: Static URLs admitted Windows alternate streams/device/trailing-dot aliases
findings.fix: Reject Windows namespace aliases and ambiguous paths; bound asset reads and avoid reading HEAD bodies

findings.problem: Host CLI accepted ambiguous duplicate flags and orphan numeric arguments
findings.fix: Validate a strict CLI before building or binding

findings.problem: Build could follow linked sources/output and replace last good output before all preparation completed
findings.fix: Validate plain trees and use guarded staged publication with recovery of the previous distribution

findings.problem: Windows hash cmdlet was unavailable; leaf-only reparse checks missed linked ancestors
findings.fix: Use core .NET stream SHA-256, check ancestors and constrain temporary cleanup

findings.problem: Release gate could miss native syntax/import/version checks; Node default reporter broke TAP summaries
findings.fix: Check UI/package/launcher versions and generated payload, parse native PowerShell and require explicit bounded TAP output

findings.problem: Legal VFS content with JSON escape expansion could save successfully then exceed its own reload/restore limit
findings.fix: Share a 32 MiB UTF-8 volume/backup envelope bound across save, reload, restore and UI while preserving the 2 MiB VFS quota

findings.problem: A submitted command waiting for management release could ignore SIGINT and mutate afterward
findings.fix: Keep an abortable waiting-command controller and cancel before executing the queued list
